import sys
import random


def main():
    seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    q = rng.randint(1, 8)
    hi = rng.choice([5, 30, 120, 300])
    lines = [str(q)]
    for _ in range(q):
        a = rng.randint(1, hi)
        b = rng.randint(1, hi)
        if a > b:
            a, b = b, a
        lines.append(f'{a} {b}')
    print('\n'.join(lines))


main()
